Chariot Artificial Intelligence, an Indian AI company, has unveiled Chariot One, a family of language and speech models trained from scratch in India.
Its largest language model contains nearly eleven billion parameters, but selectively activates around four billion for each token it processes.
Its IndicShift technology represents characters from twelve Indian scripts using a shared alphabet, reportedly reducing the number of tokens needed by up to sixty percent.
Another innovation, called Nested Training, allows three differently sized models to be developed through a single training run.
Chariot's speech model also supports English and at least ten Indian languages, interpreting numbers, abbreviations and measurements in context.
Supported by the IndiaAI Mission, Chariot is helping build AI technology designed around India's own linguistic diversity.
